variations.title: Variations
variations.subtitle: Raise, approve and track changes to the contract scope and value
variations.noContractHint: Variations are raised against the project's main contract. Add and execute a contract first.
variations.emptyHint: Raise a variation to propose a change in scope or value. The contract value moves only once a variation is client-approved.
variations.loadFailedHint: Something went wrong loading the variations. Try again.

contractValue.rule: Contract value changes only when a variation is client-approved. Pending variations are shown for information and are never added into the governing value.

create.title: Raise a variation
create.subtitle: Draft a change to the contract. Add line items — additions and omissions — then save as a draft.
create.timeImpactHint: Proposed only. It never moves the completion date on its own — record an extension of time for that.
create.netPreviewHint: A preview only. The saved variation shows the value derived by the server.

detail.subtitle: Variation order
detail.loadFailedHint: Something went wrong loading it. Try again.
detail.noLines: No line items on this variation.
detail.clientRefHint: The signed variation number or client letter reference.

toast.internalApproveFailed: Could not internally approve the variation

eot.title: Extension of time
eot.explainer: Moving the completion date is an explicit, recorded act. A variation's proposed time impact is justification you may cite — it is never applied automatically.
eot.emptyHint: The completion date has not been moved. Record an extension of time to change it.
eot.loadFailed: Could not load the extension history.
eot.grantSubtitle: Move the contract completion date. This is an explicit, audited change.
eot.citeHint: Reference variations as justification. Citing a variation does not apply its proposed time impact — this act sets the date.
eot.noVariations: No variations on this contract to cite.

toast.grantFailed: Could not record the extension of time
